leads.claim: The Air Materiel Command (AMC) has not yet obtained physical evidence of unidentified sightings.
leads.why: The document explicitly states that no physical evidence has been obtained, serving as a negative assertion rather than a lead.

leads.claim: The Air Materiel Command (AMC) T-2 intelligence division retained a report and drawings regarding German Horten tailless aircraft.
leads.why: The material described is identified as conventional German aeronautical technology (Horten brothers design) rather than UAP-related material.

leads.claim: Objects resembling falling aircraft with smoke and debris were observed near Bakersfield, California.
leads.why: The description refers to conventional aircraft-like debris and does not suggest anomalous material.

doc_verdict: The document contains no evidence of obtained UAP material and explicitly states on multiple pages that no such physical evidence has been acquired by the Air Materiel Command.
